Theorem 1 (Chapter 128)

Subject: spectral theory | ID: 5287

Proof

Step 1. By the self-adjoint spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01280011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the self-adjoint spectral family.

Step 3. The semisimple operator \(B_{01280013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle B_{01280013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through exponential approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
